name: Audio Manager Lite
headline: Switch speakers and microphones with one key.
description:
Audio Manager Lite gives Stream Deck two simple, useful Windows audio jobs: switch your Default Output device or switch your Default Input microphone with a key.

Create separate keys for speakers, headphones, a monitor, a USB DAC, microphones, or other playback/capture devices. Each key remembers its target and shows the device directly on Stream Deck.

Lite is intentionally direct-device-only. It does not include Audio Profiles, Communications routing, profile capture/apply/cycle/status, microphone mute, saved volume/mute restore, or Stream Deck+ profile volume.

Need to switch your entire setup at once? Audio Manager Pro adds complete Audio Profiles for output + input + Communications roles, plus capture/apply/cycle/status, restore state, mic control, and Stream Deck+ profile volume.

Starter layouts are included for Standard/MK.2, XL, Stream Deck+, and Neo with both speaker and microphone keys ready to configure.

Runs locally on Windows. Requires Windows 10+ and Stream Deck 7.3+.

Part of the PackRat ecosystem.
release_notes: Initial release. Free Windows Default Output and Default Input switching with bundled speaker/microphone starter layouts and Audio Manager Pro upgrade path.
